resources.string: These are the defaults. While something plays, you can change its language or subtitles just for it.
You often switch videos to %1$s. Make it the language of all videos? You can change it anytime in Settings.
You often pick %1$s subtitles. Show them in all videos? You can change it anytime in Settings.
You often turn subtitles off. Turn them off for all videos? You can change it anytime in Settings.
